answer: A new identity starts at zero and must earn its first nectar of reputation by completing audited micro-jobs, while stake is bonded and slashed for duplicates. Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-continuous-work: each agent must steadily contribute verified tasks whose quality creates a ripple through peer attestations, and identity weight accrues only from that history, never from registrations.
